facts: P16 catalogue validation performs strict duplicate-key/nonfinite JSON parsing, semantic diagnostics, then a typed ItemCatalogDocument deserialization. Manual string rosters for item kinds, locations, channels, weapon skills and book leaves are redundant policy populations requiring concrete recipient comparison; final typed schema rejects unknown enum values, limiting acceptance-side drift. Diagnostics are deliberately separate from accepted typed storage.

Coverage and melee precision are explicitly rejected as authored catalogue inputs because they are derived from placement surface spans and generated recipes respectively. Weapon carry coordinates tags/parents/held roots; armor protection belongs only to armor kind payload. Dimensions and projected physical/grip distances remain separately authored quantities needing existing producer propagation evidence, not equivalent by their units.

Pinned Serde f32 visitors cast f64 to f32, including nonfinite overflow; serde_json Value's numeric deserializer visits stored f64. Therefore positive_f32_in's conversion-aware guard supplies a real catalogue admission limit beyond source f64 finiteness. P16 physical dimensions branch checks source finite positivity only, so concrete downstream representation/admission must be compared before any accepted defect. No parser or catalogue was executed.
